# Logo provenance

- Commissioned logo for Vin's Atelier, designed by the artist Portus Workstation: Instagram @portus_workstation (art account, https://www.instagram.com/portus_workstation/) and @wason25_pz (main account, https://www.instagram.com/wason25_pz/).
- Delivered 2026-11-10. Owner: Vincent Wesley.
- **All rights reserved. Not covered by the MIT licence** of the code in this repository; do not reuse outside Vin's Atelier projects.
- Credit is required: every credits card carries "Logo by @portus_workstation / @wason25_pz".
- `svg/` files are the delivered SVGs with the hidden artboard frame and Illustrator metadata removed and the viewBox cropped; path geometry and colours are untouched. Originals (.ai, .pdf) are kept locally in the gitignored `source/`.
